name: Operator: protagonist
description: The protagonist, the Meshy pilot: body and a separately modeled head grafted at the collar, his pack skinned to the Spine bone.

made_with.settings: multi-image, 4K texture; body, head and pack separately, then tools/prep_operator.py (graft, tidy, remesh, bake, --rig); Meshy auto-rig; tools/add_fingers.py (finger bones, relaxed curl as rest pose)

notes: 59,600 faces: 47,600 body, head and hands, 12,000 pack, two textures. Mixamo-named finger bones (LeftHandIndex1-4 ...) added 2026-10-15, with knuckle loops and a relaxed curl as the rest pose; clips without finger tracks leave the fingers relaxed. The pack is part of the skinned mesh, weighted fully to Spine (Blender misplaces bone children of Meshy's 0.01-scaled armature). Cleaned 2026-10-14: collar hem, holes, orange specks, scalp in the hair. Known: the filter grilles are soft; the pack's waist strap floats beside the jacket.
